_note: Predictive Sandbox R&D content. Family: background_field. Texture: ambient noise, atmospheric mood, baseline conditions that don't force action but color everything. Routes heavily on mode=atmospheric, semantic_state=mixed/frictional, and pass_state=RESIDUAL_FIELD/LATENT.

entries.title: A Plateau of Mixed Noise
entries.body: The active signals don't align into a single cohesive push, but they are holding steady at a high volume. This is the texture of an unsettled environment—public mood, group sentiment, or general logistics—that feels loud but directionless. It colors everything but dictates nothing.
entries.notes: mixed + plateau + atmospheric: loud, directionless background noise.

entries.title: A Low-Level Irritant Fades
entries.body: The environment has been broadly uncooperative, but the gradient is finally releasing. The friction wasn't a sharp crisis, just a constant drag on the baseline condition. That drag is now slowly lifting, making ordinary operations feel slightly easier again.
entries.notes: frictional + releasing: a baseline annoyance starting to dissipate.

entries.title: A Quiet Charge Gathers
entries.body: The signals are active but technically in a latent phase before their primary approach. The operation points toward activation, but the environment is merely holding the charge right now. It is the feeling of weather changing before the storm actually hits.
entries.notes: LATENT + activate + atmospheric: the calm before the movement.

entries.title: A Favorable Echo
entries.body: The main event is over, but its reinforcing structure remains in the background field. This creates a generally supportive atmosphere—a lingering goodwill or structural soundness that makes ongoing tasks feel well-supported, even if nothing new is happening.
entries.notes: reinforcing + RESIDUAL_FIELD: a supportive, quiet aftermath.
